report.root_cause: The StatsCache plugin config was reloaded at 08:04:34 with retain-history=true (history-size 1000). Heap rose from about 399 MB to 693 MB of 768 MB within about 60 s of that reload, and the server then went DOWN before my next check, disconnecting Steve_Mines and Alex_Builds. The logs contain no explicit OutOfMemory or crash line, so the exact cause of the process exit is not confirmed; the StatsCache history retention is the most likely source of the heap growth and was the only config change in that window. Who made the change at 08:04:33 is unknown.
report.actions: Checked status and logs (server UP, TPS 20, heap 394 MB). Observed heap rise from 399 MB to 693 MB after the StatsCache retain-history=true reload at 08:04:34. Declared incident. Read plugins/StatsCache/config.yml (retain-history: true, history-size: 1000). Found the server DOWN with no crash line in the logs. Set plugins/StatsCache/config.yml to retain-history: false and history-size: 1000 (the value it ran with at startup). Started the server. Both players rejoined at 08:06:30. Watched for about 2 minutes: TPS 20, MSPT about 0.5, heap fell from 477 MB to 330 MB and stayed flat. Did not restart the server beyond the single start, did not ban or delete anything.
report.residual_risk: The retain-history=true change was reverted without knowing who made it or why, so if the team wanted history retention it is now off. The StatsCache leak itself is not confirmed as root cause, and the server exit was not explained by any log line. Heap should be watched; the server went down once already. The player disconnect and about 2 minutes of downtime were caused by the outage.
